integrity: Exact 13-column relation matrix, Smith normal form, modular ranks, single-step deletion checks, and integral chain-homotopy proof in attached files.
scientific_limitations: Integral first regular GLMY path homology only; no higher-degree classification, no global cardinality minimality, no independent validation. Short-relation family requires t>=109 and n>2(t+11).
title: An inclusion-minimal 13-step circulant family with integral three-torsion
